description: Send a sponsorship inquiry, including the sponsor's name, email, and optional phone and website, to a Soundcheck organization, which creates an inbound sponsor lead it follows up on. Requires organization_id, name, and email. User confirmation: nothing is sent until the person confirms: the first call returns confirmation_required with a summary of exactly what will be shared and a confirmation_token, and only a second call carrying that token submits it.

confirmation_token.description: user confirmation. Absent on the first call, which sends nothing and returns a summary plus this token; present only once the person whose details these are has seen that summary and agreed to share them with the organization.

organization_id.description: the Soundcheck organization to approach (slug or id)

sponsorship_interest.description: what they want to sponsor / their interest

website.description: the sponsor's website or company URL

name: request_sponsorship

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Request sponsorship
